::: {#def-interventional-npsem .theorem}
# Interventional NPSEM

The [NPSEM](#def-npsem) obtained from $\mathcal{M}$ by replacing the structural equations of the variables in $\mathbf E$ with the intervention equations of [intervention regime](#def-intervention-regime) $\Gamma$.

$$
\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)} = \{f_V^{(\Gamma)}: V \in \mathbf V \} \qquad
f_V^{(\Gamma)} = \begin{cases} h_V & \text{if } V \in \mathbf E\\ f_V & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$
:::
